title: hazardia ferrisiae
intro: Hazardia ferrisiae, commonly known as the Purple Sage or Purple Fleabane, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary properties. The health benefits of Hazardia ferrisiae include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
